% lp2graph canonical LaTeX
% Railway real‑time rescheduling MILP (capacity, frequency, additional stops)
%@ meta id=rail_reschedule family=milp schema=0.1.0
%@ name :: Real‑time railway disruption management MILP
%@ desc :: Adjust train capacities, add extra train runs, and permit additional stops to satisfy changed passenger demand while minimizing operational cost.
%@ index I ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Trains (original schedule)
%@ index S ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Stations
%@ index O ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Origin stations
%@ index D ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Destination stations
%@ param a shape=I,S kind=matrix domain=bool :: Original stop indicator (1 if train i stops at station s)
%@ param cap shape=I kind=vector domain=capacity :: Base passenger capacity of train i
%@ param cap_car shape=- kind=scalar domain=capacity :: Capacity contributed by one additional car
%@ param cost_cap shape=I kind=vector domain=cost :: Cost per additional car for train i
%@ param cost_freq shape=I kind=vector domain=cost :: Cost per extra train run for train i
%@ param cost_stop shape=I,S kind=matrix domain=cost :: Cost for adding a stop of train i at station s
%@ param demand shape=O,D kind=matrix domain=passengers :: Passenger demand from origin o to destination d
%@ var addc shape=I domain=integer role=primary drole=- lo=0 hi=- :: Number of extra cars added to train i
%@ var z shape=I domain=integer role=primary drole=- lo=0 hi=- :: Number of extra identical runs of train i
%@ var y shape=I,S domain=binary role=primary drole=- lo=- hi=- :: Indicator of an additional stop of train i at station s
%@ var x shape=I,O,D domain=continuous role=primary drole=- lo=0 hi=- :: Passengers of OD pair (o,d) assigned to train i
%@ obj sense=min name=total_cost combination=sum :: Minimize total operational cost (extra capacity, extra runs, additional stops)
%@ con demand_satisfaction kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Serve all passenger demand
%@ con capacity_limit kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Capacity of each train must not be exceeded
%@ con stop_allowed kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Additional stops only where not originally present
\begin{align}
  \min\quad & \sum_{i \in \mathcal{I}} \mathit{cost\_cap}_i \cdot addc_i \;+\; \sum_{i \in \mathcal{I}} \mathit{cost\_freq}_i \cdot z_i \;+\; \sum_{i \in \mathcal{I},\, s \in \mathcal{S}} \mathit{cost\_stop}_{i,s} \cdot y_{i,s} \tag{total\_cost} \\
  & \sum_{i \in \mathcal{I}} x_{i,o,d} \;=\; \mathit{demand}_{o,d} \qquad \forall o \in \mathcal{O},\; \forall d \in \mathcal{D},\; o \neq d \tag{demand\_satisfaction} \\
  & \sum_{o \in \mathcal{O},\, d \in \mathcal{D}} x_{i,o,d} \;\le\; \mathit{cap}_i \;+\; \mathit{cap\_car} \cdot addc_i \;+\; \mathit{cap}_i \cdot z_i \qquad \forall i \in \mathcal{I} \tag{capacity\_limit} \\
  & y_{i,s} \;\le\; 1 \;-\; \mathit{a}_{i,s} \qquad \forall i \in \mathcal{I},\; \forall s \in \mathcal{S} \tag{stop\_allowed}
\end{align}

% lp2graph canonical LaTeX
%@ meta id=rail_reschedule family=milp schema=0.1.0
%@ name :: Real-time railway disruption management MILP
%@ desc :: Model decides additional stops and capacity increases for trains to satisfy passenger demand while minimizing resource usage.
%@ index T ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Trains.
%@ index S ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Stations.
%@ param cap0 shape=T kind=vector domain=seats :: Baseline seat capacity of each train.
%@ param d shape=S kind=vector domain=passengers :: Passenger demand at each station.
%@ param orig shape=T,S kind=matrix domain=binary :: Indicator if train originally stops at station (1) or not (0).
%@ param base_cap shape=T,S kind=matrix domain=seats :: Baseline capacity contributed by train t at station s (cap0_t if orig_{t,s}=1, else 0).
%@ param Kmax shape=T kind=scalar domain=integer :: Maximum number of additional stops allowed per train.
%@ param Zmax shape=T kind=scalar domain=integer :: Maximum extra capacity units that can be added to a train.
%@ param c_cap shape=- kind=scalar domain=cost :: Cost per unit of capacity increase.
%@ param c_stop shape=- kind=scalar domain=cost :: Cost per additional stop.
%@ var y shape=T,S domain=binary role=primary drole=- lo=- hi=- :: Additional stop decision (1 if train t adds stop at station s).
%@ var z shape=T domain=integer role=primary drole=- lo=0 hi=- :: Extra capacity units added to train t.
%@ obj sense=min name=total_cost combination=sum :: Minimize total cost of capacity increases and additional stops.
%@ con demand_sat kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Ensure served capacity meets demand at each station.
%@ con add_stop_limit kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Limit number of additional stops per train.
%@ con cap_inc_limit kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Limit capacity increase per train.
%@ con no_dup_stop kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Prevent adding stop where already present.
\begin{align}
  \min\quad & \mathit{c\_cap} \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} z_{t} \;+\; \mathit{c\_stop} \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}, s \in \mathcal{S}} y_{t,s} \tag{total\_cost} \\
  & \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} \bigl( \mathit{base\_cap}_{t,s} \;+\; \mathit{cap0}_{t} \cdot y_{t,s} \;+\; \mathit{orig}_{t,s} \cdot z_{t} \bigr) \ge d_{s} \qquad \forall s \in \mathcal{S} \tag{demand\_sat} \\
  & \sum_{s \in \mathcal{S}} y_{t,s} \le Kmax_{t} \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T} \tag{add\_stop\_limit} \\
  & z_{t} \le Zmax_{t} \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T} \tag{cap\_inc\_limit} \\
  & y_{t,s} \le 1 - \mathit{orig}_{t,s} \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T}, s \in \mathcal{S} \tag{no\_dup\_stop} \\
\end{align}
